第14章 长湖与项平
“是因为他足够残忍。”
李通崖话音未落，李长湖只觉得一股寒意爬上脊梁，瞳孔骤然扩大，浑身寒毛卓竖。他盯着弟弟带着笑意的脸庞，心中凛然。
“哈哈哈哈哈哈哈…”
推了推李长湖的肩膀，李通崖将手中木简轻轻一抛，轻笑着看着李长湖。
“你这孩子。”
李长湖长出了口气，只当李通崖在开玩笑，轻轻地摆了摆手，开口道：
“我去筹备项平的婚礼。”
李长湖言罢整了整衣物，迈出门往田家去了。
李通崖却收敛了笑容，静静地坐在木桌旁，开口说：
“父亲。”
“千万别客气！”
他望着眼前随风起伏的芦苇荡，生他养他的地方，若不是这片慷慨的芦苇荡，他李叶生早就不知道死在了哪个角落。
却见李木田已经神不知鬼不觉地站在了石阶上，板着脸不知在想些什么，闻言偏头看着李通崖。
“替我多谢家主了！这情徐伯一家承下了。”
“徐伯。”李长湖站起身拍拍裤腿，关切地问道：
“怎么样，家里的粮还够吃吗？”
“项平哥！”
“听闻读书要交束修，我哥哥不会给我钱的。”
李项平却打量了他一阵，淡淡地说：“我们之间不必搞这一套，我去求爹爹便是替你交了。”

谁知李通崖同样放心不下弟弟，偷偷摸摸地尾随，两人见了面一阵尴尬，默契地看着李项平杀了人，又亲眼看着野兽分食干净，李木田这才下了山。
“谢谢哥！”
徐老汉见了李长湖眼泪就下来了，他年老了身体还算健朗，家里唯一的长子却一病不起，连田也种不齐。
“过几日我便去求爹，让他和先生讲讲，平日里你无事就去他那里多读读书，有疑惑处也大可问我们。”
他依稀记得盛儿抱着条大青鱼，笑嘻嘻地喊着：“兄长兄长，看我！”通崖明明羡慕不已，却总是偏过头嘟着嘴不去看他。三人玩累了就站在河边尿尿，比谁尿得高，比谁尿得远。
“这怎么好意思！”
李长湖已经迅速从伤感中走了出来，正色道：
“家父前几日还嘱咐我多关照徐老的田子，我这不就找过来了。”
“罪不至此啊！”
李长湖去了田家定好了婚约的诸多事宜，愣愣地坐在田上，神色复杂，他在村里走了一遭，唯独没见着李叶盛。
李木田心中压抑，说话也不讲究了，他眯了眯眼，又开口道：
“够了够了！”
“瓜娃子杀了那废物杀的好，他若是仅仅恐吓一番，老子跳下去就把那废物砍了！杀的好，杀的好！老子生什么气？你休要为李长湖遮掩！”
回忆起弟弟昨夜里那声低喝和李通崖的暗示，李长湖晓得叶盛多半已经被项平杀了。
“长湖！”
“这…”
“还有大伯一家。”他默默地想着，却望见芦苇荡钻出个人影。
————
李长湖给他减了租子，又送了粮，这才勉强熬过来，徐老汉是看着李长湖长大的长辈，本就将他当孩子看，又走了这么一遭，心中已经感激极了。
“来。”李项平神色有些复杂，将布包往李叶生手中一塞，开口道：

“来来来。”
“放屁！”李木田一拍桌面，面上多了几分怒意：
“这些是我开蒙时的读物，你平时里放鸭时大可多看些。”
李木田昨夜坐在门前正望着月，就见着李项平风风火火地冲向了后山，心中放心不下，悄悄跟在孩子身后上了后山。
“诶，哪里能说得上承情，应该做的！”李长湖摆摆手。
李项平笑着从布袋中取出一个白馍，往他手中一递，李叶生连忙接过，狼吞虎咽咬着，含糊地说：
“哥对我最好了！”
看着李通崖低头不语，李木田语气缓和了许多，低声说：
“从前我不怕，有你们两个兄弟，李长湖宽厚是最好不过，恩威并施，未来可期。但如今不同了，我李家怀壁其罪，如履薄冰，掌事者若是不够狠辣则轻易覆亡啊！”
“我生个劳子气！”
“哈哈哈哈哈。”
李长湖眼角有了些晶莹，他总觉得能再劝劝他，再让他学好，认真保护好弟弟叶生，好好活着。
却是一个白发的老农户，长相憨厚老实，皮肤黝黑，穿着土布衣，裤管宽大得很。
只是后来伯母死了，二伯也卧病在床，叶盛短短数月性情大变，再也不是从前的他了。
“他们敬的是我李木田！围着你哥哥只是李长湖的租子低！这些人向来畏威不怀德，你看他这模样，我李木田今天一死，明天李叶盛就敢上门打滚，他李长湖敢杀他？”
李通崖长叹一声，闷闷地说：
李叶生惊喜地站起身，自从主家盖了高院，李项平就不常出来走动了，据说成日里在院中读书，李叶生只有去主家吃饭才能碰见他。
“大哥宽厚心善，村里人和租户们都对他敬服不已，是能保家业的。”
“项平也是出于家族安危，父亲也不必动怒…”李通崖劝慰道。
李叶生正掰着指头数数，自言自语道：

“前日去了三伯处，大前日去的大伯处，四伯昨日里把我赶出来了，今天只能煮点野菜抓点虾子煮汤喝喝了。”
李叶生惊喜交加，连连推迟，心中又是不安又是期待，连连摆手。
两人在田上聊着，李项平却提着布包到了芦苇荡边，默默地看着坐在岸边的李叶生。
李项平和李叶生混得最近，小时候也偷偷拿家里东西给李叶生吃，李木田睁一只眼闭一只眼下，李项平还真给他带了不少东西。
李长湖心中一阵痛苦，小时候叶盛和通崖小小的两只，总是乖乖地跟在自己身后下河捞鱼。
“再者。”李木田喘了口气，眼中忧虑不安：
“这几日我心中总是坠坠不安，只怕有杀身之祸。”
李叶生感动不已，鞠了捧河水洗了洗手，这才小心翼翼地将布包收好。
徐老汉老成了精，哪能不知道李长湖在给李木田做人情，莞尔一笑，对着李长湖拱了拱手，笑道：
一声叫唤惊醒了李长湖，他连忙低下头擦了擦眼角，望向出声处。
李叶生还想说些什么，望着李项平淡的表情没由来地升起一股敬畏，心中暗道：
“项平哥好像大伯啊！”
李项平却不知李叶生心中所念，拍了拍他的肩膀，嘱咐好读书的事宜，便回家去了。
ps:真的不是在水，感觉进度有点快了，借着李叶盛来丰富立体一下主角们的形象QAQ
[大哭]求票票，求追读。
(本章完)

Chapter 14 Changhu and Xiang Ping
"Because he is cruel enough."
Before Li Tongya finished speaking, Li Changhu felt a chill creeping up his spine, his pupils suddenly dilated, and his hair stood on end. He stared at his younger brother's smiling face, feeling stern in his heart.
"Hahahahahahaha..."
Pushing Li Changhu's shoulder, Li Tongya gently tossed the wooden slip in his hand and looked at Li Changhu with a chuckle.
"You kid."
Li Changhu took a deep breath, thinking that Li Tongya was joking, gently waved his hand, and said:
"I'm going to prepare for Xiang Ping's wedding."
After Li Changhu finished speaking, he straightened his clothes and walked out to Tian's house.
Li Tongya suppressed his smile, sat quietly at the wooden table, and said:
"Father."
"Don't be polite!"
He looked at the undulating reed marsh in front of him, the place where he was born and raised. If it weren't for this generous reed marsh, he, Li Yesheng, would have died in an unknown corner.
However, they saw that Li Mutian was already standing on the stone steps without anyone noticing, with a stern expression on his face. He didn't know what he was thinking. Hearing this, he turned his head and looked at Li Tongya.
"Thank you, Master, for me! Uncle Xu's family has accepted this favor."
"Uncle Xu." Li Changhu stood up, patted his trouser legs, and asked with concern:
"How's it going? Do you still have enough food at home?"
"Brother Xiang Ping!"
"I heard that studying has to be handed over to Shu Xiu. My brother won't give me money."
However, Li Xiangping looked at him for a while and said calmly: "There is no need for us to engage in this kind of thing. I will beg daddy to hand it over for you."
Unexpectedly, Li Tongya was also worried about his younger brother and followed him secretly. The two of them were embarrassed for a while when they met. They watched Li Xiangping kill someone in tacit understanding and watched the beast eat them up before Li Mutian went down the mountain.
"Thank you bro!"
Old man Xu burst into tears when he saw Li Changhu. He was still in good health despite his old age, but the only eldest son in the family was ill and could not even cultivate the land.
"In a few days, I will go to my father and ask him to talk to my husband. If you have nothing to do on weekdays, you can go to his place to read more. If you have any questions, you can ask us."
He vaguely remembered Sheng'er holding a big herring and shouting with a smile: "Brother, brother, look at me!" Tongya was obviously envious, but he always turned his head and pouted, not looking at him. When the three of them got tired of playing, they stood by the river to pee, competing to see who could pee higher and farther.
"How embarrassing!"
Li Changhu quickly came out of his sadness and said seriously:
"My father told me to take more care of Mr. Xu's fields a few days ago, so I'm here to find him."
"This is not the end of the crime!"
Li Changhu went to Tian's house and settled many matters of the marriage contract. He sat blankly on the field with a complicated expression. He walked around the village but did not see Li Yesheng.
Li Mutian felt depressed and was no longer particular about his words. He narrowed his eyes and said again:
"Enough is enough!"
"Guawazi killed that good-for-nothing, well done. If he had just threatened, I would have jumped down and chopped that good-for-nothing! Well done, well done! Why am I angry? Don't cover up for Li Changhu!"
Recalling his brother's low voice last night and Li Tongya's hint, Li Changhu knew that Ye Sheng had probably been killed by Xiang Ping.
"Long Lake!"
"This..."
"There is also the uncle's family." He thought silently, but saw a figure emerging from the reed swamp.
————
Li Changhu reduced his rent and gave him food, and he managed to survive. Old man Xu was an elder who watched Li Changhu grow up, and he treated him as a child. After being away for such a long time, he was already extremely grateful.
"Come." Li Xiangping looked a little complicated, stuffed the cloth bag into Li Yesheng's hand, and said:
"Come on, come on."
"Fart!" Li Mutian slapped the table with a hint of anger on his face:
"These are the books I read when I was in elementary school. You can read more when you are free."
Last night, Li Mutian was sitting in front of the door and looking at the moon. He saw Li Xiangping rushing towards the back mountain in a hurry, and he felt uneasy.Next, he quietly followed the child up the back mountain.
"Hey, how can I say that I am grateful? I should do it!" Li Changhu waved his hand.
Li Xiangping smiled and took out a white bun from the bag and handed it to him. Li Yesheng quickly took it, wolfed it down and said vaguely:
"Brother is the best to me!"
Seeing Li Tongya lowering his head and saying nothing, Li Mutian softened his tone a lot and whispered:
"I wasn't afraid in the past. With you two brothers, it would be best for Li Changhu to be generous and generous. He can be both kind and powerful, and the future is promising. But it's different now. Our Li family is guilty of crimes and is walking on thin ice. If the person in charge is not ruthless enough, it will easily fall!"
"I'm so angry at Laozi!"
"Hahahahaha."
The corners of Li Changhu's eyes were sparkling. He always felt that he could persuade him again and let him learn well, protect his younger brother Ye Sheng seriously, and live well.
He is an old farmer with white hair, a simple and honest appearance, dark skin, wearing homespun clothes, and his trousers are very wide.
But later, his aunt died and his second uncle became ill in bed. Ye Sheng's temperament changed drastically in just a few months, and he was no longer the same person.
"They respect me, Li Mutian! They surround your brother because Li Changhu's rent is low! These people have always been fearful of power and have no morals. Look at his appearance. If I, Li Mutian, die today, Li Yesheng will dare to come to your door tomorrow. Li Changhu will dare to kill him?"
Li Tongya sighed and said dullly:
Li Yesheng stood up in surprise. Since the master's house built a high court, Li Xiangping didn't go out often. It was said that he was studying in the courtyard all day long. Li Yesheng could only meet him when he went to the master's house for dinner.
"My eldest brother is generous and kind-hearted. The villagers and tenants all respect him. He can protect the family business."
"Xiang Ping is also worried about the safety of his family, so there is no need for his father to be angry..." Li Tongya comforted him.
Li Yesheng was counting on his fingers and said to himself:
"I went to my third uncle's house the day before yesterday, and my uncle's house the day before yesterday. My fourth uncle kicked me out yesterday. Today I can only cook some wild vegetables and shrimps to make soup."
Li Yesheng was filled with surprises and delayed again and again. He was filled with uneasiness and expectation, and waved his hands again and again.
The two were chatting in the field, but Li Xiangping carried the cloth bag to the reed marsh and silently looked at Li Yesheng sitting on the bank.
Li Xiangping and Li Yesheng were close friends. When they were young, they secretly gave Li Yesheng food from home. Li Mutian turned a blind eye and Li Xiangping actually brought him a lot of things.
Li Changhu felt a pain in his heart. When he was a child, Ye Sheng and Tongya Xiaoxiao always followed him obediently into the river to catch fish.
"Moreover." Li Mutian took a breath, with worry in his eyes:
"I have been feeling uneasy these past few days, fearing that I might be killed."
Li Yesheng was so moved that he drank some river water and washed his hands before carefully putting the bag away.
Old man Xu has become a mature man. How could he not know that Li Changhu was doing favors for Li Mutian? He smiled, cupped his hands towards Li Changhu, and said with a smile:
A cry woke up Li Changhu. He quickly lowered his head and wiped the corners of his eyes, looking at the place where the sound came from.
Li Yesheng still wanted to say something. Looking at Li Xiang's plain expression, he felt a sense of awe for no reason, and thought to himself:
"Brother Xiang Ping looks like an uncle!"
Li Xiangping didn't know what Li Yesheng was thinking, so he patted him on the shoulder, told him about studying, and went home.
ps: It’s really not in the water. I feel that the progress is a bit fast. I use Li Yesheng to enrich the three-dimensional image of the protagonists QAQ
